sections.title: Direct Lines for Every Inquiry
sections.body: We believe in direct communication and fast response times. Depending on your interest, we have dedicated teams ready to handle your request. For institutional investors seeking Data Room access or term sheet discussions, our Investor Relations (IR) team is available across major time zones. For AI startups and DePIN node operators looking to secure 300kW-1MW capacity, our Sales & Solutions team can provide customized quotes and technical consultations. We also welcome inquiries from technology partners and equipment suppliers who want to participate in our upcoming tenders. Whether you are in Nairobi, Dubai, or Silicon Valley, we are only a click away from starting a productive partnership. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit economics so stakeholders can track progress with confidence.
